Class ApiCodeValue

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.security.extension.exception.ApiCodeValue
public final class ApiCodeValue extends Object
Centralised registry of integer API codes used by the authentication and authorisation layers of the easy-4-java security stack.

The constants follow the convention 100xx for authentication failures, 1002x for authorisation/token failures and 10030 for third-party authorisation server failures. Each value is referenced by a corresponding AuthResponseCode constant.

Since:
3.0.0
Author:
[@Loong Wan](https://github.com/loong10k)
